transcript: Speaker A: This is the Ocean. An ocean is very large. It has a lot of salt water. This is the Sea. A sea is smaller than an ocean. The water is salty. This is a Lake. A lake is surrounded by land. The water is usually fresh. This is a Pond. A pond is small and quiet. This is the Stream. A stream is a small river. This is a Canal. A canal is made by people. This is a Bay. A bay is water surrounded by land. This is a Gulf. A gulf is a large part of the sea. This is a Puddle. A puddle is a small pool of water. This is a River. A river flows across the land.
